body.name: quadratic-endpoint local-cubic learning handle
body.construction: On each training fold of size \(M\), use a deterministic \(h_M\)-partition of \([0,1]^2\), normalized monomials of total degree at most three, at-risk weighted local Nelson--Aalen equations for \(\lambda_a\), and direct weighted local equations for \(q_a=S_ag_a\); recover \(g_a\) by division by the survival generated from the hazard fit, clip all primitive fits to their known bands, and use deterministic in-band fallbacks whenever a random Gram eigenvalue is below its class-known population-scale threshold.
